format: per take: per tick part rot (xRot,yRot,zRot rad), offset_px from the vanilla pivot, forward and up in blocks (forward 0 = touchdown block centre, positive = still ahead of it), ring glow. 'cells': per crater block (dx, dz in blocks from the landing block) the tick it lights ('lit') and the tick it is gone ('cleared'), relative to touchdown. 'mobs': hit tick and launch velocity. 20 ticks a second.
crater_rule: landing block turns construct 0.8 s and stays; ring d = round(euclid distance) lights at tick d-1, is gone at tick 4 + 2d
